actionCalls.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: synchronously invokes processGiftCommitment on the just-created GC after the N Yearly N=1 GCSs land (Create_Custom_GCSs). Platform activates the schedules, populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransactionDate + NextTransactionAmount, and fans out Expected GTs for future-dated rows. Past-dated rows are skipped by the fanout engine — Loop_Build_Custom_GTs hand-authors compensating GTs downstream, gated by Decide_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT. Fault path shares Err_Create.
actionCalls.name: Process_Custom_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Custom Commitment

actionCalls.description: Phase G2. Mirrors Process_Recurring_Commitment but targets the employer's parallel Recurring GC (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC). Activates the employer schedule so CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransaction fields populate. Runs after Create_Employer_Recurring_GCS. Connector routes to Create_Employer_Recurring_GDD to persist the employer's default designation.
actionCalls.name: Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Employer Recurring Commitment

actionCalls.description: Phase C.3 fix: mirrors Process_Scheduled_Commitment but for the Recurring Gift leaf. Activates the open-ended schedule so CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId, NextTransactionAmount, NextTransactionDate populate immediately after the launcher completes.
actionCalls.name: Process_Recurring_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Recurring Commitment

actionCalls.description: Phase C.2a fix: after Create_Scheduled_Schedule, synchronously invokes Salesforce's processGiftCommitment standard action against the just-created GC. This activates the schedule (populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId, NextTransactionDate, NextTransactionAmount) and fans out the first Expected GT. Without this the record waits for the once-daily FQS_Coordinate_Gift_Commitment_Processing batch at 01:00 UTC. Fault path routes to Err_Create — if the org has no default GiftDesignation the action returns INVALID_API_INPUT ("The org wide default designation is not yet configured..."), which surfaces via the shared error screen. Once flowed to a healthy org, the action succeeds silently and the connector routes to Decide_Create_Default_Designation to continue the launcher.
actionCalls.name: Process_Scheduled_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Scheduled Commitment

actionCalls.description: Simple-leaf-adds-GCS refactor: synchronously invokes processGiftCommitment on the just-created GC after the Yearly N=1 GCS lands. Mirrors Process_Scheduled_Commitment / Process_Recurring_Commitment. Activates the schedule, populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransactionDate + NextTransactionAmount, and fans out the single Expected GT for future-dated pledges. For past-dated pledges the platform activates the schedule but does NOT fan out — the downstream Decide_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT hand-authors a compensating GT. Fault path shares Err_Create.
actionCalls.name: Process_Simple_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Simple Commitment

assignments.description: Phase F3a (launcher plan §Employer picker line 117). Stages rsv_MatchACR ahead of Create_MatchACR. Roles = 'Employee' (native ACR picklist value; standard value set exists on AccountContactRelation.Roles across all orgs). IsActive left to platform default (true). No other fields stamped — no need to guess Title / StartDate; user can enrich on the ACR record if desired.
assignments.name: Assign_ACR_Fields
assignments.label: Stage ACR Fields

assignments.description: GDSC Item B — Stages rsv_GiftDefaultSoftCredit for insert on the parent GC. ParentRecordId is polymorphic (Campaign/GC/Opportunity — NOT Account, per [[gdd-parent-polymorphic]] which applies identically to GDSC). Role comes from the pkGDSCRole radio on Screen_Pick_SoftCredit_Commitment. PartialPercent is optional — null means the platform propagates the recipient across every GT as a full soft credit; non-null means fractional recognition. Runs on GC-creating leaves (Simple ref; Recurring/Grant/Pledge clones next) when pkCommitmentNeedsSoftCredits=Yes.
assignments.name: Assign_Build_Default_SoftCredit
assignments.label: Build DefaultSoftCredit

assignments.description: GDSC Item C — Inside Loop_Fanout_GDSC_To_GSC. Builds one GiftSoftCredit row per GDSC on the parent GC, stages it into col_GSCs_FromGDSCs for bulk-insert on loop drain. Also increments var_GSCsFanoutCount so Screen_Success can render a summary line.
assignments.name: Assign_Build_GSC_From_GDSC
assignments.label: Build GSC from GDSC (loop body)

assignments.description: Builds a self-recognition GiftSoftCredit for the In-Kind gift. Recipient = donor Account (recordId); PartialAmount = FMV (SoftCreditAmount is a platform-derived field — not writable — the platform populates it from PartialAmount on insert). Role 'In-Kind Recognition' keeps this pattern distinguishable from third-party soft credits in reports. Runs automatically for every In-Kind gift with a positive FMV, independent of the user's pkNeedsSoftCredits choice — the manual soft-credit picker recognizes a related Account for a cash gift; this element recognizes the donor themselves for the non-cash value.
assignments.name: Assign_Build_InKind_SelfCredit
assignments.label: Build In-Kind Self-Credit

assignments.name: Assign_Build_Split_GTD_Campaign
assignments.label: Build Split GTD (Campaign loop body)

assignments.description: Designation hierarchy multi-GDD support — body of Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_GC. Mirrors Assign_Build_Split_GTD_Campaign but connects back to Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_GC.
assignments.name: Assign_Build_Split_GTD_GC
assignments.label: Build Split GTD (GC loop body)

If the GC has no Campaign (Q12), Get_Campaign_For_Commitment returned 0 rows and rsv_SelectedCampaign remains null; the downstream .Id IsNull gate on Assign_Campaign_Onto_Transaction still correctly skips the GT.CampaignId write in that case.
assignments.name: Assign_Campaign_From_Commitment_Selected
assignments.label: Use Commitment's Campaign as Selected

assignments.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. Per iteration of Loop_Confirm_Paid_GTs, mutates the in-flight GiftTransaction (rsv_ConfirmedGTLoopItem, which carries the Id from Get_PastDue_GTs) to Status='Paid'. Appends the mutated row onto col_ConfirmedPaidGTs for bulk Update by Update_Confirmed_Paid_GTs on loop drain. TransactionDate is deliberately left untouched — the money cleared on its original due date. No entry-date stamp on this path: past-payments confirmation is a status flip, not a fresh entry.
assignments.name: Assign_Confirm_Paid_Row
assignments.label: Mark Confirmed Row as Paid

assignments.description: Phase Guide.1 — GiftCommitment-context entry stager. Runs only when the flow is invoked as a subflow from FQS_Gift_Entry_Guide_GiftCommitment (contextCommitmentId input is set). Writes recordId with the commitment's DonorId so the downstream Account-prep chain (Get_Account → Get_Account_Contacts → Get_CampaignMembers → Get_Member_Campaigns) runs correctly against the donor's Account. rsv_SelectedCommitment was already populated by Get_Context_Commitment (via outputReference), so no SObject-copy here — that pattern silently drops field values on downstream reads. The Pledge Payment leaf then keys on `contextCommitmentId IsNull false` at each PP-branch decision to reach Assign_Defaults_PledgePayment / employer / GDSC / restriction / designation-resolver code paths without needing to write pkLeafMonetary (unwritable auto-var).
assignments.name: Assign_Context_Entry
assignments.label: Stage GC-Context Entry

assignments.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: inside Loop_Build_Custom_GCSs — for each RepeaterItem on CustomInstallmentsRepeater.AllItems, builds one Yearly N=1 GiftCommitmentSchedule linked to the parent commitment. Mirrors Assign_Simple_Schedule_Row (TransactionPeriod=Yearly, TransactionInterval=1, Type=CreateTransactions, TransactionDay clamped for day-29-31, EndDate clamped forward for past dates) but reads per-row Amount/Date from CustomInstallmentsRepeater.AllItems. assignments.name: Assign_Custom_GCS_Row
assignments.label: Build Custom GCS Row (Yearly N=1)

assignments.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: inside Loop_Build_Custom_GTs — for each row of col_CustomGCSs (now stamped with Ids after Create_Custom_GCSs), builds one Expected GiftTransaction linked to the parent commitment AND its per-row GCS via GiftCommitmentScheduleId. Uses the shared PaymentMethod from Screen_Scheduled_Details, the donor Account id (recordId), and the per-row date + amount from the GCS cursor. Only runs on past-dated rows (see Decide_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT) — future-dated rows come from platform fanout after Process_Custom_Commitment. FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c='Pledge Payment' because these are the expected installments that pay down the pledge. CampaignId is NOT propagated to the GTs from the parent GC — reading rsv_GiftCommitment.CampaignId throws "field hasn't been set or assigned" if the user skipped the campaign picker; reports roll up via GiftCommitmentId regardless.
assignments.name: Assign_Custom_GT_Row
assignments.label: Build Custom GT From Repeater Item

assignments.description: Phase C.2b-collapse: seeds col_CustomScheduleRows with a single empty GiftCommitmentSchedule template row before Screen_Scheduled_Details renders. The Repeater on that screen (visible when Equal=No) uses col_CustomScheduleRows as its bound collection; without at least one seed row the Repeater renders empty and the user can't see the fields until they click Add. Template row is used purely for the Repeater's field-default binding — its values are never inserted. Also clears col_CustomGTs since the user may re-run this branch after Back-nav.
assignments.name: Assign_Custom_SeedFirstRow
assignments.label: Seed First Custom Row

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch). Stages rsv_MatchEmployerGT ahead of Create_Employer_GT. DonorId = employer Account (from lkpMatchEmployer.recordId). OriginalAmount = numMatchAmount. GiftType = Organizational (employer Account is always org / non-Person). TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate mirror the donor GT's TransactionDate. FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c = 'Outright Gift' because the employer's payment is a fresh outright gift from their perspective, not a pledge payment even when the donor GT is. PaymentMethod = 'Check' is the pragmatic default; user can edit downstream. TaxReceiptStatus = 'Don't Send'. Name is left null so the FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction before-save flow fills it (parity with the Custom-branch installments). GiftCommitmentId is NOT assigned here — it's stamped downstream by Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment for the Pledge Payment / Recurring branches; on Outright + match it stays null (launcher plan lines 92-104: Outright Gift+match leaves both GTs orphan). Deliberately does NOT read rsv_GiftTransaction.GiftCommitmentId — that field is never set on the Outright branch, and any Flow read of an un-assigned SObject field throws "field hasn't been set or assigned."
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_Fields
assignments.label: Stage Employer Match GT

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch, lines 92-104). Stamps rsv_MatchEmployerGT.GiftCommitmentId = rsv_SelectedCommitment.Id on the Pledge Payment + match branch (both branches — Fresh Insert and Update Existing — always populate rsv_SelectedCommitment before Screen_Gift_Details, so this read is always safe here). On Recurring Gift + match (Phase F3) this Assign will be extended to also handle the new-commitment Id (rsv_GiftCommitment.Id after Create_Pledge lands). On Outright Gift + match, the flow bypasses this Assign entirely via Decide_Employer_GT_Parent_To_Commitment (both GTs stay orphan per launcher plan).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToCommitment
assignments.label: Employer GT parent → Commitment

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stamps rsv_MatchEmployerGT.GiftCommitmentId = rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC.Id so the employer's first-payment GT parents to the newly created employer Recurring GC (parity with the donor's Create_Recurring_First_Payment_GT pattern).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToEmployerRecurringGC
assignments.label: Employer GT parent → Employer Recurring GC

assignments.description: Phase G2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch, Recurring leaf). Stages the parallel Recurring GiftCommitment on the employer Account. Mirrors Assign_Recurring_Defaults one-for-one with two swaps: DonorId=lkpMatchEmployer.recordId (employer Account) and Name=formulaEmployerRecurringCommitmentName (employer-name-based). Cadence (RecurrenceType=OpenEnded, FulfillmentType=Unconditional, FormalCommitmentType=Verbal, EffectiveStartDate=dtRecurringStart, IsAssetTransferExpected=false) matches the donor GC. FQS_Match_Eligible__c is deliberately false — this IS the match commitment, not one that would itself be matched. CampaignId inherited from rsv_SelectedCampaign.Id (safe: on Recurring + match branch, Screen_Pick_Campaign_Pledge runs before we reach here via Decide_PostMatch_Campaign_Router → Screen_Pick_Campaign_Pledge → downstream flow lands the campaign on rsv_SelectedCampaign). GC.ScheduleType is intentionally NOT set on insert (platform-managed).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GC
assignments.label: Defaults: Employer Recurring GC

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stages the open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for the employer's parallel Recurring GC. Same cadence as the donor's schedule (TransactionPeriod=pkRecurringPeriod, TransactionInterval=numRecurringInterval, StartDate=dtRecurringStart, TransactionDay=formulaRecurringTransactionDay) but TransactionAmount=numMatchAmount so expected match GTs fan out at the match value. PaymentMethod defaults to Check (employer payment method typically differs from donor; user can edit later). Type=CreateTransactions engages the NPC fan-out. No EndDate — open-ended per the donor's cadence.
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GCS
assignments.label: Build Employer Recurring Schedule Row

assignments.description: Phase G2. Stages the GiftDefaultDesignation on the employer's Recurring GC. GiftDesignationId mirrors the donor's picked designation (rsv_SelectedDesignation.Id) so employer expected GTs fan out to the same fund. AllocatedPercentage=100 (single default; user can add more later).
assignments.name: Assign_Employer_Recurring_GDD
assignments.label: Build Employer Default Designation

assignments.description: G4: Employer-source router path (b): user did NOT pick a row from dtEmployers, so the fallback flowruntime:lookup on Account.ParentId governs. Copies lkpMatchEmployer.recordId into varEmployerAccountId, which every downstream match node reads. Connector routes to Get_Match_Employer to load FQS_Match_Ratio__c / Annual Max / Matching_Gift_Program__c for the picked employer.
assignments.name: Assign_EmployerId_FromLookup
assignments.label: Employer Id ← Lookup

assignments.description: G4: Employer-source router path (a): user selected a row from dtEmployers on Screen_Pick_Match_Employer. dtEmployers' firstSelectedRow lands in rsv_SelectedEmployer; this Assign copies rsv_SelectedEmployer.Id into varEmployerAccountId, which every downstream match node reads. Connector routes to Get_Match_Employer to load FQS_Match_Ratio__c / Annual Max / Matching_Gift_Program__c for the picked employer.
assignments.name: Assign_EmployerId_FromTable
assignments.label: Employer Id ← Datatable

assignments.description: Cash-flow path (non-In-Kind). Assign the Amount input to OriginalAmount. The platform derives CurrentAmount from OriginalAmount on insert and derives TaxDeductionAmount from CurrentAmount − NonTaxDeductibleAmount — neither is written here. Writes the split-date inputs (dtGiftDate → TransactionDate, dtDonorTaxDate → FQS_Donor_Tax_Date__c). TransactionDueDate mirrors dtGiftDate.
assignments.name: Assign_Fanout_Amount
assignments.label: Fan out Amount

assignments.description: Phase G7.d — Event Registration fanout. Writes the full payment to OriginalAmount (so hard-credit rollups reflect what changed hands) and the material-benefit portion to NonTaxDeductibleAmount. The platform-derived TaxDeductionAmount then lands at OriginalAmount − NonTaxDeductibleAmount, giving the donor their partial deduction automatically. numEventRegBenefit is required on Screen_Gift_Details when pkLeafSpecial=EventRegistration, so it's never null here.
assignments.name: Assign_Fanout_Amount_EventReg
assignments.label: Fan out Amount (Event Registration)

assignments.description: In-Kind path. In-kind gifts are non-cash so OriginalAmount = 0 (platform-derived CurrentAmount will also be 0, keeping hard-credit rollups cash-only). FMV comes from numEventRegBenefit — the same "Fair Market Value Amount" input shared with the Event Registration leaf on Screen_Gift_Details (single admin-visible field, dual purpose per visibility rule). Written to the FMV custom field. NonTaxDeductibleAmount is explicitly zeroed so the platform-derived TaxDeductionAmount also lands at 0 — the donor determines the actual tax-deductible value on their own return. TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate both come from dtGiftDate (the shared Received Date input; the In-Kind ObjectProvided TransactionDate binding was retired 2026-08-04 so the screen shows one date field for every leaf).
assignments.name: Assign_Fanout_Amount_InKind
assignments.label: Fan out Amount (In-Kind)

assignments.description: GDSC Item C — Router body for Pledge Payment leaf. Stamps var_GDSCFanout_ParentGCId = rsv_SelectedCommitment.Id (the picked GC from Screen_Pick_Commitment; always populated on PP). Downstream Get_GC_GDSCs queries GDSCs off this Id.
assignments.name: Assign_Fanout_ParentId_FromCommitment
assignments.label: Stamp Fanout Parent Id (from picked GC)

assignments.description: GDSC Item C — Router body for Recurring first-payment leaf. Stamps var_GDSCFanout_ParentGCId = rsv_GiftCommitment.Id (the just-created Recurring GC). Downstream Get_GC_GDSCs queries GDSCs off this Id — captures the GDSC the user opted in for on Screen_Recurring_Details (Item B) so the first payment gets a matching GSC.
assignments.name: Assign_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC
assignments.label: Stamp Fanout Parent Id (from new GC)

assignments.description: Designation hierarchy Phase 5d follow-up — stages the platform-auto GDD row for Update_GC_GDD, rewriting its GiftDesignationId to the resolver's pick (var_ResolvedDesignationId, which for Override paths is the user's manual pick). AllocatedPercentage is preserved at 100 because the platform's auto-insert always uses 100 in the single-GDD case; multi-GDD is skipped upstream via the reconciliation gate.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_GDD_Update_Fields
assignments.label: Stage GC GDD Update

assignments.description: GDSC Item B fix — Router body when user checked chkUseGDSCLookup and picked via the fallback flowruntime:lookup. Copies lkpGDSCRecipient.recordId into var_GDSCRecipientId.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSCRecipient_FromLookup
assignments.label: GDSC recipient — from lookup

assignments.name: Assign_GDSCRecipient_FromTable
assignments.label: GDSC recipient — from datatable

assignments.description: Pre-populates rsv_GiftTransaction with smart defaults before Screen_Gift_Details renders. ObjectProvided screen fields display the record variable's current value as the shown default, so seeding TransactionDate = TODAY and PaymentMethod = Cash here makes those defaults visible on the screen. Also guards Bug 3: without a TransactionDate seed, the Name formula (which concatenates TEXT(TransactionDate)) yields null and Create_Gift_Transaction fails with REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING [Name]. IsNull-gate (Phase E, launcher plan): the assigned value is a formula that returns the existing value if non-null, else the fallback default (TODAY / Cash). This preserves prefilled values (e.g., Get_Commitment_Schedule.PaymentMethod = ACH) from Assign_Prefill_From_Schedule instead of stomping them. See .planning/fqs-gift-entry-wizard-plan.md §State at handoff prefill IsNull-gate policy.
assignments.name: Assign_Gift_Details_Defaults
assignments.label: Defaults for Gift Details

assignments.description: Phase F3b (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Soft credits, lines 132-136). Stages rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor ahead of Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor. Recognizes the corporate Account on the donor's GT — GiftTransactionId = donor GT (rsv_GiftTransaction.Id), RecipientId = employer Account (lkpMatchEmployer.recordId), Role = 'Matched Donor' (native picklist value verified via describe). Phase G3: PartialAmount = formulaDonorGiftAmount (BLANKVALUE(numGiftAmount, numRecurringAmount)) — the DONOR GT's amount, not the match amount. Previously used numMatchAmount which is only correct on the employer-side row. SoftCreditAmount is a platform-derived field (not writable — populated from PartialAmount on insert). Legal donor is never soft-credited to their own transaction (parity with corporate-match-plan §Core rules) — that's handled by placing the corporate on the DONOR GT, not by attributing the donor to themselves.
assignments.name: Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor
assignments.label: Stage Match SoftCredit (Donor GT)

assignments.description: Phase F3b (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Soft credits, lines 132-136). Stages rsv_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer ahead of Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer. Recognizes the donor Person Account on the employer's GT — GiftTransactionId = employer GT (rsv_MatchEmployerGT.Id), RecipientId = donor Account (recordId — the launcher context Account, always the donor Person Account on the match branch because Decide_Match_Needed gates on IsPersonAccount=true). Role and PartialAmount mirror the donor-side row.
assignments.name: Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer
assignments.label: Stage Match SoftCredit (Employer GT)

assignments.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Amount, line 124). Runs after Create_Employer_GT lands so rsv_MatchEmployerGT.Id is populated. Writes the returned employer GT Id onto rsv_GiftTransaction.MatchingEmployerTransactionId — the native GT-to-GT lookup that pairs a donor gift to its employer match (verified via describe: reference field, referenceTo=GiftTransaction, updateable=true, lives on the donor row and points UP to the paired employer row). Followed by Update_Donor_With_Pair to persist the pair (donor GT is already in the DB — insert path just wrote it, update path is about to be overwritten by Update_Gift_Transaction anyway; this Assign only mutates the record variable, DML happens in Update_Donor_With_Pair).
assignments.name: Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT
assignments.label: Pair Donor GT with Employer GT

assignments.description: Applies the selected Campaign onto rsv_GiftCommitment before create. If none selected, CampaignId stays null.
assignments.name: Assign_Pledge_Campaign
assignments.label: Campaign onto Commitment

assignments.description: Simple Pledge/Grant GC field set. ScheduleType is intentionally NOT set (platform-managed — back-fills from the Yearly GCS child inserted downstream). FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c flows from pkCommitmentSubcategory. ExpectedEndDate seeds from dtExpectedEndDate. RecurrenceType=FixedLength. NextTransactionDate + NextTransactionAmount are NOT written here — the platform derives them from the single-row GCS inserted by Assign_Simple_Schedule_Row → Create_Simple_Schedule → Process_Simple_Commitment. Custom-period GCS was tried 2026-07-30 (probe records X1xYAE, XI5YAM, XMvYAM) but Flow inputReference inserts don't trigger platform fanout on Custom schedules; reverted to Yearly with an EndDate clamp for past-date pledges.
assignments.name: Assign_Pledge_Defaults
assignments.label: Defaults: Simple Pledge / Grant

assignments.description: Phase E (launcher plan). Prefills the Gift Details screen from the picked commitment's schedule row. TransactionAmount → var_GiftAmount (Amount input default). PaymentMethod → rsv_GiftTransaction.PaymentMethod (Payment Method picklist default). Assign_Gift_Details_Defaults downstream reads these via IsNull-gated formulas (formulaDefault_TransactionDate / formulaDefault_PaymentMethod) so non-null prefilled values are preserved — see .planning/fqs-gift-entry-wizard-plan.md §State at handoff prefill IsNull-gate policy.
assignments.name: Assign_Prefill_From_Schedule
assignments.label: Prefill Amount from Schedule

assignments.description: Phase Guide.5 — Preselect stager for purposeful launcher surfaces. Runs only when preselectCategory is set (Opportunity Setup Commitment path). Copies the caller-supplied preselectCategory and preselectLeaf into the canonical effective vars so every downstream decision (Decide_Category, Decide_Leaf_Future, Decide_Insert_Schedule, Decide_After_Designation_IsPledge, Decide_Override_Needs_Restriction_IsCommitmentCreation, Decide_Route_Outright_To_Resolver_IsSimplePledge/IsScheduledPledge, Decide_Create_Default_Designation_IsScheduleLeaf, SuccessLink_GC visibilityRule) reads the same value regardless of entry surface. After the assign, connects to Get_Account so the donor-prep chain runs, then Decide_Skip_Category's new HasPreselect rule jumps past Screen_Category. Uses declared vars — cannot write to pkLeafFuture / var_Category directly per the flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input memory (screen-field auto-vars are unwritable from every external mechanism including Assignment).
assignments.name: Assign_Preselect_Effectives
assignments.label: Stage Preselect Effectives

assignments.description: Phase C.3: writes the Recurring Gift GC field set. Diverges from Assign_Scheduled_Defaults in two ways: (1) RecurrenceType=OpenEnded (not FixedLength) — the platform contract for open-ended gift streams; (2) no ExpectedTotalCmtAmount — recurring gifts have no fixed total, income is realized as payments arrive. The category is hard-set to 'Recurring Gift' (no subcategory picker on the Recurring screen). EffectiveStartDate reuses dtRecurringStart (Schedule Start = Effective Start for recurring — a single date on the screen); IsAssetTransferExpected pinned to false. GC.ScheduleType is intentionally NOT set on insert (platform-managed, back-fills from the child GCS row).
assignments.name: Assign_Recurring_Defaults
assignments.label: Defaults: Recurring Gift

assignments.description: Phase F3c (launcher plan §Recurring Gift, lines 246-249). Stages rsv_GiftTransaction for the first-payment GT that the Recurring leaf posts today. GiftCommitmentId = rsv_GiftCommitment.Id (safe — Create_Pledge already returned it). Status=Paid because FQS is retroactive: the donor already paid today. TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate = dtRecurringStart (the schedule's Effective Start; validated ≤ TODAY on Screen_Recurring_Details). OriginalAmount = numRecurringAmount, PaymentMethod = pkRecurringPaymentMethod (mirroring the pattern on every schedule-fanned Expected GT). Category='Recurring Gift Payment' per FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c value set. Name left null so FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction fills it. Deliberately does NOT write GiftType or CampaignId — the platform derives GiftType from DonorId; CampaignId propagates via GC.CampaignId if the picker filled it (reading rsv_GiftCommitment.CampaignId is unsafe if the campaign screen was skipped — [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]).
assignments.name: Assign_Recurring_First_Payment_Defaults
assignments.label: Defaults: Recurring First Payment GT

assignments.description: Phase C.3: builds the single open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Recurring Gift. Type=CreateTransactions tells the NPC engine to fan out Expected GTs per TransactionPeriod / TransactionInterval / TransactionAmount / StartDate. No EndDate — the schedule is open-ended and continues until the donor cancels (deactivates the commitment). GC.RecurrenceType=OpenEnded (set in Assign_Recurring_Defaults) plus the null EndDate on GCS keep the stream running.

Flow.description: Screen flow launched via quick action from an Account record. Records either a GiftTransaction (Outright, In-Kind, Earned Income, or Pledge Payment) or a new GiftCommitment (Pledge). Every path uses record variables bound to the record-creates via inputReference. Pickers (Commitment, Campaign, Designation, Soft-Credit Account) are datatables with a native lookup escape hatch. Restriction handling on the Pledge branch is driven by GiftCommitment.FulfillmentType. Every DML has a fault path to a single error screen so the user always sees why nothing was saved.

formulas.description: Phase G5 (mismatch-warning polish). Actionable delta line for the amount-mismatch warning — tells the user "That's $50.00 more than the scheduled amount." or "That's $50.00 less than the scheduled amount." Guarded on both operands non-blank (Decide_Amount_Mismatch only fires when both are set, but the formula is defensive).
formulas.name: formulaAmountMismatchDelta
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!numGiftAmount}), ISBLANK({!rsv_SelectedGT.OriginalAmount})), "", IF({!numGiftAmount} > {!rsv_SelectedGT.OriginalAmount}, "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!numGiftAmount} - {!rsv_SelectedGT.OriginalAmount}, 2)) & " more than the scheduled amount.", "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!rsv_SelectedGT.OriginalAmount} - {!numGiftAmount}, 2)) & " less than the scheduled amount."))

Phase F3c: donor amount source varies by leaf — Outright/PP use numGiftAmount (Screen_Gift_Details), Recurring uses numRecurringAmount (Screen_Recurring_Details, no numGiftAmount collected). BLANKVALUE(numGiftAmount, numRecurringAmount) picks whichever is populated on the current branch. User can still override on the screen. Uses BLANKVALUE to null-coalesce the ratio because Flow formulas cannot ISNULL a lookup-result Number field without the parent Get_Match_Employer having run — BLANKVALUE returns the fallback on null / blank without throwing. See [[flow-screen-authoring-gotchas]] on BLANKVALUE-vs-NVL and [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]].

formulas.description: Maps the Simple-Pledge Match-Eligible radio (pkMatchEligible_Pledge) to a Boolean for rsv_GiftCommitment.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. Yes → true; No or null → false. Null happens when the radio is hidden on Corp accounts (visibility rule gates on IsPersonAccount=true); BEGINS(null, ...) returns null which the Boolean checkbox field rejects at insert with INVALID_TYPE_ON_FIELD_IN_RECORD, so the OR-with-false coerces null to false. Used by Assign_Pledge_Defaults so the three commitment leaves (Simple Pledge / Recurring / Scheduled) can convert their Yes/No radios into the underlying Boolean without introducing shared variables.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Pledge

formulas.description: Phase F2.1: maps the Recurring Match-Eligible radio (pkMatchEligible_Recurring) to a Boolean for rsv_GiftCommitment.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. See formulaMatchEligible_Pledge.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Recurring

formulas.description: Phase F2.1: maps the Scheduled Match-Eligible radio (pkMatchEligible_Scheduled) to a Boolean for rsv_GiftCommitment.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. See formulaMatchEligible_Pledge.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Scheduled

formulas.description: Phase G5 (mismatch-warning polish). Actionable delta line for the match-max warning — tells the user "That's $500.00 over the annual cap." Only fires when the entered match exceeds the employer's cap (Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded already gated on numMatchAmount > FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c).
formulas.name: formulaMatchMaxDelta
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!numMatchAmount}), ISBLANK({!Get_Match_Employer.FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c})), "", "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!numMatchAmount} - {!Get_Match_Employer.FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c}, 2)) & " over the annual cap.")

formulas.description: Phase C.3: Auto-generated Name for a Recurring Gift commitment. No fixed total (recurring is open-ended); prints the installment amount + period word so the record is scannable in list views. Category is literal "Recurring Gift" from Assign_Recurring_Defaults.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringCommitmentName

formulas.description: Phase C.3-derive: interval word for the Recurring plain-English summary (mirrors formulaScheduledIntervalWord).
formulas.name: formulaRecurringIntervalWord
formulas.expression: CASE(LEFT(TEXT({!numRecurringInterval}), 1), "1", "every", "2", "every other", "3", "every third", "4", "every fourth", "5", "every fifth", "6", "every sixth", "7", "every seventh", "8", "every eighth", "")

formulas.description: Phase C.3-derive: period lowercase for Recurring commitment Name and preview sentence ("every month" not "every Monthly").
formulas.name: formulaRecurringPeriodWord

formulas.description: Phase C.3-derive: full plain-English recurring schedule preview for the DisplayText field. Open-ended — no total, no end date, no payment count.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringPreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!numRecurringAmount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!numRecurringAmount})) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaRecurringIntervalWord}), "___", {!formulaRecurringIntervalWord}) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaRecurringPeriodWord}), "___", {!formulaRecurringPeriodWord}) & " starting " & {!formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay} & ", continuing indefinitely until the donor cancels."

formulas.description: Phase C.3-derive: friendly-format the Recurring schedule Start Date as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Phase C.3-fix: day-of-month from dtRecurringStart for GiftCommitmentSchedule.TransactionDay (a picklist of "1".."31"). Without this, Monthly schedules default to day 1 for all payments after the first — a schedule starting on the 18th would post 2nd payment on the 1st.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringTransactionDay

formulas.description: Phase C.2a: Auto-generated Name for a Scheduled Pledge/Grant GiftCommitment. Pattern mirrors formulaGiftCommitmentName but reads numScheduledTotal for the amount. Category still comes from rsv_GiftCommitment.FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c (picklist stringValue, NOT the RadioButton choiceText which carried an em-dash description into the Name field pre-refine).
formulas.name: formulaScheduledCommitmentName

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: final payment date. StartDate + (Interval * Period) * (Count - 1). Weekly = 7 days per unit; Monthly = ADDMONTHS 1 per unit; Yearly = ADDMONTHS 12 per unit. Uses pkScheduledPeriod stringValue, not choiceText, via a null-safe TEXT read.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledEndDate
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!dtScheduledStart}), ISBLANK({!numScheduledPaymentCount}), {!numScheduledPaymentCount} <= 1), {!dtScheduledStart}, IF({!pkScheduledPeriod} = "Weekly", {!dtScheduledStart} + ({!numScheduledInterval} * ({!numScheduledPaymentCount} - 1) * 7), IF({!pkScheduledPeriod} = "Monthly", ADDMONTHS({!dtScheduledStart}, {!numScheduledInterval} * ({!numScheduledPaymentCount} - 1)), IF({!pkScheduledPeriod} = "Yearly", ADDMONTHS({!dtScheduledStart}, {!numScheduledInterval} * ({!numScheduledPaymentCount} - 1) * 12), {!dtScheduledStart}))))

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: friendly-format the Scheduled schedule End Date as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: recurring installment amount. Total / Count, floored to cents so N * installment <= Total; the last real payment absorbs any leftover (handled downstream by the schedule engine or by a future finalizer). FLOOR(x*100)/100 avoids floating-point $0.005 drift.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: interval word for the plain-English summary — the numScheduledInterval selection carries the numeric multiplier (1/2/3/4); this maps it back to the display word.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledIntervalWord
formulas.expression: CASE(LEFT(TEXT({!numScheduledInterval}), 1), "1", "every", "2", "every other", "3", "every third", "4", "every fourth", "5", "every fifth", "6", "every sixth", "7", "every seventh", "8", "every eighth", "")

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: period lowercase for plain-English summary ("every third month" not "every third Monthly"). Handles trailing s: month/week/year, not months.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledPeriodWord

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: full plain-English schedule preview for the DisplayText field. Uses Mon DD, YYYY date formatting via formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay / formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay so dates read as prose, not ISO. Each token has a ___ fallback so partial input still shows the sentence structure.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledPreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount})) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledIntervalWord}), "___", {!formulaScheduledIntervalWord}) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledPeriodWord}), "___", {!formulaScheduledPeriodWord}) & " starting " & {!formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay} & " until " & IF(ISBLANK({!numScheduledTotal}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!numScheduledTotal})) & " is given, over " & IF(OR(ISBLANK({!numScheduledPaymentCount}), {!numScheduledPaymentCount} <= 0), "___", TEXT({!numScheduledPaymentCount})) & " payments. Final payment expected around " & {!formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay} & ". If total does not divide evenly, the last payment absorbs the remainder."

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-derive: friendly-format the Scheduled schedule Start Date as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence. Flow TEXT(date) produces yyyy-mm-dd, which is unpleasant in prose.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Phase C.2a-fix: same as formulaRecurringTransactionDay but reads dtScheduledStart. Prevents day-1-of-month drift on the Scheduled Pledge/Grant (Regular) leaf.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledTransactionDay

formulas.description: Simple-leaf-adds-GCS refactor: GCS.EndDate value. For future-dated pledges (dtExpectedEndDate >= TODAY), use the user-entered date verbatim. For past-dated pledges (donor pledged in the past but is only now being recorded), clamp EndDate forward to TODAY so the platform's fanout window still includes at least one open day and generates the Expected GT. The Expected GT itself still lands with TransactionDueDate = GCS.StartDate = dtExpectedEndDate, so the user-facing due date remains the original past date.
formulas.name: formulaSimpleGCSEndDate

formulas.description: Simple past-date leaf: derives FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c for the hand-authored Expected GT built when a Single-Payment pledge/grant has a past date. Reads pkCommitmentSubcategory (the Single-Payment leaf's subcategory picker) — "Grant Payout" → "Grant Payment", otherwise "Pledge Payment". Same rationale as formulaCustomGTCategory.
formulas.name: formulaSimplePastDateGTCategory

formulas.description: Simple Pledge preview: plain-English summary of the single-installment pledge/grant. Reads numPledgeAmount + dtExpectedEndDate on Screen_Pledge_Details.
formulas.name: formulaSimplePreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!numPledgeAmount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!numPledgeAmount})) & " on " & {!formulaSimpleStartDateDisplay} & " as a single payment."

formulas.description: Simple Pledge preview: friendly-format dtExpectedEndDate as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaSimpleStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Simple-leaf-adds-GCS refactor: day-of-month from dtExpectedEndDate for GiftCommitmentSchedule.TransactionDay (a picklist of "1".."31" plus "LastDay"). Clamps 29/30/31 to "LastDay" because the platform rejects day-29-31 for months that don't have those dates. See [[gc-current-schedule-activation]].
formulas.name: formulaSimpleTransactionDay

formulas.description: Designation hierarchy multi-GDD support — per-row GTD Amount for the split fanout. Multiplies rsv_GiftTransaction.OriginalAmount by rsv_SplitGDDLoopItem.AllocatedPercentage / 100. Rounded to 2 decimals to match currency precision. If OriginalAmount is null (defensive), returns 0.
formulas.name: formulaSplitGTDAmount

formulas.description: Phase G6 (Success screen rewrite). Renders the paired-match amount as "$250.00" for the Success screen match line. Guarded via BLANKVALUE. The employer Name is rendered inline as {!Get_Match_Employer.Name} in the SuccessMatchLine DisplayText fieldText — that field's visibility rule (pkNeedsMatch=Yes) gates evaluation so the .Name read only runs on match=Yes paths where Get_Match_Employer already fired.
formulas.name: formulaSuccessMatchAmount

formulas.description: Phase G6 (Success screen rewrite). Renders a leaf-specific one-line summary sentence for Screen_Success. References ONLY top-level scalar variables (pkLeaf*, num*, dt*) — never SObject field-paths — so it evaluates safely on every terminal path without tripping [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]. The three leaf radios (pkLeafMonetary / pkLeafFuture / pkLeafSpecial) are mutually exclusive per run — only the one whose category was picked on Screen_Category is populated — so BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE(monetary, future), special) yields a single key we CASE on. Dates on monetary/special paths use TODAY() rather than the user-entered TransactionDate — the entered date lives on rsv_GiftTransaction.TransactionDate which we can't read cross-path without throwing on pledge branches. TODAY() is accurate for the default (unmodified) case and off by at most a few days for backdated entries; a small imprecision on a confirmation screen we deemed acceptable versus the alternative of gating summary lines with visibility rules per leaf.
formulas.name: formulaSuccessSummary
formulas.expression: CASE(BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE({!pkLeafMonetary}, {!pkLeafFuture}), {!pkLeafSpecial}), "Outright", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numGiftAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Outright Gift on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "PledgePayment", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numGiftAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Pledge Payment on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "Recurring", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numRecurringAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Recurring Gift starting " & {!formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay} & ".", "Simple", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numPledgeAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Single Payment Pledge/Grant.", "Scheduled", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numScheduledTotal}, 0), 2)) & " Scheduled Pledge/Grant starting " & {!formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay} & ".", "InKind", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numEventRegBenefit}, 0), 2)) & " In-Kind Gift on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "EarnedIncome", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numGiftAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Earned Income payment on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "EventRegistration", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numGiftAmount}, 0), 2)) & " Event Registration on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & " ($" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!numEventRegBenefit}, 0), 2)) & " benefit).", "Record created.")

formulas.description: Phase G6 (Success screen rewrite). Renders TODAY() as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the Success summary sentence on monetary + special paths where no dedicated start-date scalar exists. Same date-format shape as formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay.
formulas.name: formulaTodayDisplay

Flow.interviewLabel: FQS Gift Entry Single Launcher — Account {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: FQS Gift Entry Single Launcher — Account

loops.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: first pass — iterates CustomInstallmentsRepeater.AllItems (synthetic collection of RepeaterItem records; each item has field_Custom_Date and field_Custom_Amount) and for each item builds a fresh Yearly N=1 GCS in Assign_Custom_GCS_Row, appending to col_CustomGCSs for bulk insert by Create_Custom_GCSs. No assignNextValueToReference — the current loop item is referenced as {!Loop_Build_Custom_GCSs.field_Custom_Date} / .field_Custom_Amount (see memory: flow-repeater-output-quirk).
loops.name: Loop_Build_Custom_GCSs
loops.label: Build Custom GCSs From Repeater

loops.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: second pass — after Create_Custom_GCSs bulk-inserts the N Yearly N=1 GCSs and Process_Custom_Commitment activates them (platform fans out future-dated Expected GTs), iterates col_CustomGCSs to hand-author compensating Expected GTs only for past-dated rows (platform refuses to fan those out — same rule as Simple past-date branch). Assigns the loop cursor to rsv_CustomGCS_LoopItem so Decide_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT can compare StartDate to TODAY and Assign_Custom_GT_Row can read TransactionAmount/StartDate/Id off it.
loops.name: Loop_Build_Custom_GTs
loops.label: Build Custom Past-Date GTs

loops.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. Iterates col_SelectedPastDueGTs — the collection the user checked on Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments (bound to the flowruntime:datatable's selectedRows output). Body Assign_Confirm_Paid_Row flips each row's Status to Paid, appending onto col_ConfirmedPaidGTs for bulk Update by Update_Confirmed_Paid_GTs. Empty-selection case (user unchecked everything) drains immediately and Update_Confirmed_Paid_GTs no-ops with an empty collection.
loops.name: Loop_Confirm_Paid_GTs
loops.label: Loop Confirmed Past-Due GTs

loops.description: GDSC Item C — iterates Get_GC_GDSCs (the parent GC's GDSCs) to build one GiftSoftCredit per row into col_GSCs_FromGDSCs. On drain, Create_GSCs_FromGDSCs bulk-inserts. Reached from Decide_Fanout_GDSC_To_GSC when the leaf has a parent GC (PP or Recurring first-payment) AND Get_GC_GDSCs returned rows. If the collection is empty (GC has no GDSCs), the loop drains immediately and Create_GSCs_FromGDSCs inserts an empty list (no-op).
loops.name: Loop_Fanout_GDSC_To_GSC
loops.label: Fan out GDSCs to GSCs

loops.description: Designation hierarchy multi-GDD support — iterates Get_Campaign_GDDs_Multi to fan out one GTD per Campaign GDD onto the just-created GT (rsv_GiftTransaction.Id) when var_PlatformSplitApplies=true and var_CampaignGDDCount > 1. Reached from Decide_Split_Source_For_Fanout's default branch. Body Assign_Build_Split_GTD_Campaign appends a per-row GTD to col_SplitGTDs; on drain, Create_Split_GTDs bulk-inserts. Amount per row = rsv_GiftTransaction.OriginalAmount * (AllocatedPercentage / 100).
loops.name: Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_Campaign
loops.label: Fan out split GTDs (Campaign)

loops.description: Designation hierarchy multi-GDD support — iterates Get_GC_GDDs_Multi to fan out one GTD per GC GDD onto rsv_GiftTransaction (PP branch only). Body Assign_Build_Split_GTD_GC appends a per-row GTD to col_SplitGTDs; on drain, Create_Split_GTDs bulk-inserts.
loops.name: Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_GC
loops.label: Fan out split GTDs (GC)

recordCreates.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: bulk-inserts the N Yearly N=1 GCSs built by Loop_Build_Custom_GCSs — one GCS per user-entered installment row. Each GCS parents to rsv_GiftCommitment.Id with Type=CreateTransactions, so Process_Custom_Commitment can activate them and the platform fans out future-dated Expected GTs. Past-dated GCSs still get inserted (they anchor the schedule) but the platform refuses to fan out GTs for them; Loop_Build_Custom_GTs hand-authors compensating GTs on the second pass. Fault path shares Err_Create.
recordCreates.name: Create_Custom_GCSs
recordCreates.label: Create Custom GCSs

recordCreates.description: Custom-adds-GCS-per-row refactor: bulk-inserts the hand-authored compensating Expected GTs for past-dated Custom-branch rows. Only rows whose StartDate < TODAY reach here (see Decide_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT). Each GT already has GiftCommitmentId (parent commitment) and GiftCommitmentScheduleId (the per-row Yearly N=1 GCS just inserted by Create_Custom_GCSs) stamped. The FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction before-save flow fills each GT.Name after insert.
recordCreates.name: Create_Custom_GTs
recordCreates.label: Create Custom Past-Date GTs

recordCreates.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch). Inserts the paired employer-match GiftTransaction via rsv_MatchEmployerGT. Reached from Decide_Insert_Employer_GT_Insert (fresh-donor-insert path) or Decide_Insert_Employer_GT_Update (pledge-payment-update path) when pkNeedsMatch=Yes. Phase F3a: connector now routes to Get_Existing_ACR (was Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT) so the flow can insert an AccountContactRelation between donor PersonContact and employer Account when one doesn't already exist. Fault path shares Err_Create — if the employer GT insert fails, the donor GT and any commitment/schedule already exist in the org and users must clean up manually (parity with all other Create_* fault contracts).
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_GT
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Match GT

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's parallel Recurring GiftCommitment (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GC). Runs on Recurring + match=Yes ahead of the employer GT insert so the employer GT can parent to it. Same platform contract as Create_Pledge — do NOT stamp ScheduleType (platform-managed). Shares Err_Create fault path.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GC
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Recurring GiftCommitment

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GCS). Connector routes to Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment to activate the schedule immediately (mirrors donor pattern). Fault path shares Err_Create.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GCS
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Recurring GiftCommitmentSchedule

recordCreates.description: Phase G2. Inserts the employer's GiftDefaultDesignation (rsv_EmployerRecurring_GDD) so future employer expected GTs fan out to the same designation the donor picked. Runs after Process_Employer_Recurring_Commitment activates the schedule. Connector proceeds to Assign_Employer_GT_ParentToEmployerRecurringGC to stamp the employer GT's parent GC and continue into Create_Employer_GT. Fault path shares Err_Create.
recordCreates.name: Create_Employer_Recurring_GDD
recordCreates.label: Create Employer Default Designation

recordCreates.description: Creates the GiftTransaction via inputReference on rsv_GiftTransaction. All fields set through prior Assignments and ObjectProvided screen bindings. Phase F2: connector now routes to Decide_Insert_Employer_GT_Insert (was Decide_Create_InKind_SelfCredit). When no match is opted-in, that decision defaults straight through to Decide_Create_InKind_SelfCredit so the existing terminal chain (In-Kind self-credit → designation → soft credit → Screen_Success) is unchanged.
recordCreates.name: Create_Gift_Transaction
recordCreates.label: Create Gift Transaction

recordCreates.description: GDSC Item B — Inserts rsv_GiftDefaultSoftCredit on the just-created parent GC. Runs on GC-creating leaves (Simple ref; Recurring/Grant/Pledge clones next) when pkCommitmentNeedsSoftCredits=Yes. Fault path shares Err_Create — a GDSC insert failure leaves the GC + designation state intact; user has to add the soft credit manually. Connector routes to Screen_Success.
recordCreates.name: Create_GiftDefaultSoftCredit
recordCreates.label: Create Gift Default Soft Credit

recordCreates.description: GDSC Item C — Bulk-inserts col_GSCs_FromGDSCs (built by Loop_Fanout_GDSC_To_GSC). One GSC per GDSC on the parent GC, all parented to rsv_GiftTransaction.Id. If the collection is empty (GC had no GDSCs), this insert is a no-op. Fault path shares Err_Create — a failed insert leaves the just-created / just-updated GT in place; user has to add soft credits manually.
recordCreates.name: Create_GSCs_FromGDSCs
recordCreates.label: Create GSCs from GDSCs

recordCreates.description: Creates the auto-generated self-recognition GiftSoftCredit for In-Kind gifts. Ensures the donor sees the FMV in NPC's soft-credit rollups (DonorGiftSummary.TotalSoftCreditsAmount, TotalHardSoftCreditsAmount) while hard-credit rollups stay cash-only.
recordCreates.name: Create_InKind_SelfCredit
recordCreates.label: Create In-Kind Self-Credit

recordCreates.description: Phase F3a (launcher plan §Employer picker line 117, §Decisions locked #2). Inserts an AccountContactRelation between the donor PersonContact and the picked employer Account so future gifts see the employer relationship. Reached only from Decide_ACR_Exists when Get_Existing_ACR returns zero rows (no prior employment relationship recorded). Fault path routes to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT instead of Err_Create — an ACR insert failure is non-critical (the paired GTs are already in the DB and the pair still succeeds); the user can add the ACR manually later. This is the "inline ACR create" escape-hatch behavior called for in the plan without requiring the picker itself to be reshaped into a datatable + fallback.
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchACR
recordCreates.label: Create Match ACR

recordCreates.description: Phase F3b (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Soft credits, lines 132-136). Inserts the corporate-Account recognition GiftSoftCredit on the donor's GT (Role = 'Matched Donor', Recipient = employer Account). Fault path routes forward to Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer — a soft-credit insert failure is non-critical (both paired GTs are already in the DB); the user can add the missing soft credit manually. Success advances to the employer-side soft credit.
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor
recordCreates.label: Create Match SoftCredit (Donor GT)

recordCreates.description: Phase F3b (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Soft credits, lines 132-136). Inserts the donor-Person-Account recognition GiftSoftCredit on the employer's GT (Role = 'Matched Donor', Recipient = donor Account). Fault path routes forward to Decide_Match_Post_Route (best-effort — the pair itself is already persisted; a soft-credit insert failure doesn't abort the flow). Success also routes to Decide_Match_Post_Route which handles the branch back to Screen_Success or the terminal chain.
recordCreates.name: Create_MatchSoftCredit_OnEmployer
recordCreates.label: Create Match SoftCredit (Employer GT)

recordCreates.description: Creates the GiftCommitment via inputReference on rsv_GiftCommitment. IMPORTANT: do NOT set rsv_GiftCommitment.ScheduleType before this insert — the field is auto-managed by the platform and populates from the first GiftCommitmentSchedule child inserted afterwards. Setting it explicitly is silently overridden to 'Recurring' and produces a misleading error if a Custom schedule is later attached. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md § GiftCommitment.ScheduleType.
recordCreates.name: Create_Pledge
recordCreates.label: Create Pledged Gift Commitment

recordCreates.description: Phase F3c (launcher plan §Recurring Gift, lines 246-249). Posts the Recurring commitment's first payment as a Paid GiftTransaction dated dtRecurringStart. Runs after Process_Recurring_Commitment has activated the schedule and after Decide_Create_Default_Designation has run the designation fan-out. Connector routes to Decide_Insert_Employer_GT_Insert so pkNeedsMatch=Yes drops into the same employer-GT + ACR + soft-credit chain that Outright and PP use. Fault path shares Err_Create — a failed first-payment GT insert leaves the GC + GCS activated in the org (schedule engine will still fan out Expected GTs) and the user has to clean up manually or re-record the first payment, matching all other Create_* fault contracts.
recordCreates.name: Create_Recurring_First_Payment_GT
recordCreates.label: Create Recurring First Payment GT

recordCreates.description: Phase C.3: inserts the open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Recurring Gift. Runs only when pkLeafMonetary = Choice_Leaf_RecurringGift (see Decide_Insert_Schedule_IsRecurring). No EndDate — the engine will keep fanning out Expected GTs indefinitely; deactivation happens by editing the commitment or its schedule row. Shares Err_Create fault path with the other create nodes. Connector routes to Process_Recurring_Commitment to synchronously fire the Fundraising engine.
recordCreates.name: Create_Recurring_Schedule
recordCreates.label: Create Recurring GiftCommitmentSchedule

recordCreates.description: Phase C.2a: inserts the GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Regular Scheduled Pledge/Grant. Runs only when pkLeafFuture = Choice_Leaf_ScheduledPledgeGrant AND pkScheduledEqualInstallments = Yes (see Decide_Insert_Schedule). GC.ScheduleType back-fills from this GCS on the platform side after insert. Fault path shares Err_Create — a GCS insert failure leaves the parent GC orphaned in the org; users must clean up manually, matching the existing Create_Pledge fault contract. Connector routes to Process_Scheduled_Commitment to synchronously fire the Fundraising engine (activates the schedule, populates CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransaction fields, fans out the first Expected GT) — without this, the record would wait for the once-daily FQS_Coordinate_Gift_Commitment_Processing batch at 01:00 UTC.
recordCreates.name: Create_Scheduled_Schedule
recordCreates.label: Create Scheduled GiftCommitmentSchedule

recordCreates.description: Simple-leaf-adds-GCS refactor: inserts the hand-authored Expected GT for a past-dated Simple pledge. Runs only when dtExpectedEndDate < TODAY (see Decide_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT). Compensates for the platform's refusal to fan out Expected GTs for past-dated schedule windows. Parents to the just-created GC and its GCS (rsv_GiftCommitmentSchedule.Id was set by Create_Simple_Schedule's inputReference). Fault path shares Err_Create. Connector routes to Decide_Create_Default_Designation to rejoin the schedule-leaf terminal chain.
recordCreates.name: Create_Simple_PastDate_GT
recordCreates.label: Create Simple Past-Date Expected GT

recordCreates.description: Simple-leaf-adds-GCS refactor: inserts the single-installment (N=1) Yearly GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Simple Pledge/Grant. Runs only when pkLeafFuture = Choice_Leaf_SimplePledgeGrant (see Decide_Insert_Schedule_IsSimple). GC.ScheduleType platform-back-fills to Recurring from this GCS after insert. Fault path shares Err_Create. Connector routes to Process_Simple_Commitment to synchronously activate the schedule + fan out the Expected GT — without this the record waits for the daily batch.
recordCreates.name: Create_Simple_Schedule
recordCreates.label: Create Simple GiftCommitmentSchedule (N=1)

recordCreates.description: Designation hierarchy multi-GDD support — bulk-inserts col_SplitGTDs (N GTDs, one per split GDD) built by Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_Campaign / _GC. Reached from either loop's noMoreValuesConnector. Connector routes to Decide_Create_SoftCredit — the same downstream Decide_Create_Designation's default connector uses, so the terminal chain after GTD creation is unchanged. Fault shares Err_Create.
recordCreates.name: Create_Split_GTDs
recordCreates.label: Create Split Gift Transaction Designations

recordLookups.description: Loads the donor Account. Name is used on downstream screens for context text; DonorId comes straight from recordId at commit time. IsPersonAccount drives GiftType auto-derivation.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account
recordLookups.label: Get Account

recordLookups.description: Loads Contacts on this Account. Their Ids feed the CampaignMember lookup and the ACR / CCR walks used to build the soft-credit list.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account_Contacts
recordLookups.label: Get Account Contacts

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads AccountContactRelation rows for the donor Contact (Get_Account.PersonContactId). Match branch is Person-Account-only, so PersonContactId is guaranteed populated by Decide_Match_Needed. Feeds Transform_ACR_AccountIds which maps AccountId into a text collection consumed by Get_EmployerPRGs_Match. No IsActive / Roles filter — kept broad so donors with older or role-untagged relationships still surface (per design call).
recordLookups.name: Get_ACRs_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Donor ACRs

recordLookups.description: Active GiftCommitments for this donor. Used only on the Pledge Payment branch; on other transaction branches the result is unused (empty table skipped). Phase G5 (2026-07-25): filter excludes Recurring Gift commitments — recurring payments materialize on schedule via the platform engine or gateway; hand-recording an off-cycle payment against a recurring stream is a distinct use case that routes through Outright Gift (or a dedicated future leaf), not Pledge Payment.
recordLookups.name: Get_Active_Commitments
recordLookups.label: Get Active Commitments

recordLookups.description: Designation hierarchy Phase 2c — hydrates the parent Campaign of the selected commitment so Screen_Campaign_From_Commitment can display Campaign.Name in the read-only inherited-Campaign summary. Filter on rsv_SelectedCommitment.CampaignId; returns 0 rows if the commitment isn't attached to a Campaign (Q12 case) — Screen_Campaign_From_Commitment's visibility rules handle the null branch with an advisory message. Read is safe because rsv_SelectedCommitment is loaded with storeOutputAutomatically=true by both GC-picker paths, so .CampaignId is a known-populated field even when null (per [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]).
recordLookups.name: Get_Campaign_For_Commitment
recordLookups.label: Get Campaign From Commitment

recordLookups.description: CampaignMembers whose ContactId is in this Account's household. Feeds the Account-member Campaign filter.
recordLookups.name: Get_CampaignMembers
recordLookups.label: Get Campaign Members for Account

recordLookups.description: Load the commitment's schedule (recurring template) if one exists. Used only to prefill Amount from TransactionAmount.
recordLookups.name: Get_Commitment_Schedule
recordLookups.label: Get Commitment Schedule

recordLookups.description: Phase Guide.1 — Loads the GiftCommitment record identified by the contextCommitmentId input directly into rsv_SelectedCommitment (via outputReference, not storeOutputAutomatically). This pre-populates the same SObject variable that the Account-entry path fills via Screen_Pick_Commitment / Assign_Commitment_From_Lookup, so every downstream read of rsv_SelectedCommitment.Id / .CampaignId / .FulfillmentType / .FQS_Match_Eligible__c / etc. resolves correctly on the GC-entry path with a single load. NOTE: intentionally does NOT use storeOutputAutomatically+field-copy-via-Assignment — SObject-to-SObject copy via an assignments element produces a reference whose downstream field reads return null, per flow-unread-sobject-field-throws semantics on assigned SObjects. outputReference bypasses that by writing the loaded record into the pre-declared variable directly. queriedFields lists every field the monolith reads off rsv_SelectedCommitment; kept in sync with the Account-entry lookups' picked field lists. Reached only from Decide_Entry_Mode's GC-context branch. Fault routes to Err_Load — nothing has been changed yet at this point.
recordLookups.name: Get_Context_Commitment
recordLookups.label: Get Context Commitment

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads Account records whose Ids are in the Transform_PRG_AccountIds collection (i.e., the anchor Accounts of Group-type PartyRelationshipGroups tied to the donor via ACR). Provides the datatable source for dtEmployers with the five match columns (Name, FQS_Matching_Gift_Program__c, FQS_Match_Ratio__c, FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c, FQS_Is_Match_Intermediary__c). Empty result is fine — the fallback flowruntime:lookup on Account.ParentId still lets the user pick manually.
recordLookups.name: Get_EmployerAccounts_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Employer Accounts

recordLookups.description: G4: Loads PartyRelationshipGroup rows where Type='Group' (i.e., employer / organizational groups; explicitly NOT Household) and AccountId is in the Transform_ACR_AccountIds collection (donor's ACR-linked accounts). Feeds Transform_PRG_AccountIds which maps AccountId into a text collection consumed by Get_EmployerAccounts_Match.
recordLookups.name: Get_EmployerPRGs_Match
recordLookups.label: Get Employer PRGs

recordLookups.description: Phase F3a (launcher plan §Employer picker line 117, §Decisions locked #2). Checks whether an AccountContactRelation already links the donor PersonContact (Get_Account.PersonContactId) to the picked employer Account (lkpMatchEmployer.recordId). Reached from Create_Employer_GT. If found, Decide_ACR_Exists skips ahead to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT unchanged. If empty, the flow routes into Assign_ACR_Fields + Create_MatchACR so the relationship persists for future gifts. Match branch is Person-Account-only (Decide_Match_Needed gates on Get_Account.IsPersonAccount), so PersonContactId is always populated here. Fault path routes straight to Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT — an ACR-lookup failure shouldn't abort the pair. Filter uses IsActive=true to avoid short-circuiting on soft-deleted relationships (verified via describe: AccountContactRelation.IsActive is a filterable boolean, default true).
recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_ACR
recordLookups.label: Get Existing ACR

recordLookups.description: GDSC Item C — Pre-fanout guard. Query existing GSCs on rsv_GiftTransaction.Id (the just-updated or just-inserted GT). The platform's schedule engine already fans out GDSC → GSC when it materializes Expected GTs, so scheduled-payment GTs already have GSCs by the time PP Update runs; re-inserting would trip a DUPLICATE_VALUE unique key on GiftTransactionId. Decide_Existing_GSC_On_GT reads this result: rows found → skip fanout (already done by platform); zero rows → proceed to Get_GC_GDSCs. Recurring first-payment and PP Fresh Insert typically return zero rows here since the GT was just posted by this flow.
recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_GSC_On_GT
recordLookups.label: Get Existing GSCs on GT

recordLookups.description: Phase E1 (launcher plan): pull open Expected GTs already fanned out on the picked commitment (Status IN Unpaid / Pending / Failed), ordered by TransactionDueDate ASC. Feeds the Screen_Existing_GTs datatable so the user can post an existing scheduled payment rather than double-inserting a fresh one. Zero-row case (Simple Pledge, fully-posted schedule) routes past the datatable and falls through to the existing fresh-insert path via Decide_Has_Existing_GTs.
recordLookups.name: Get_Existing_GTs
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Open Gift Transactions

recordLookups.description: Designation hierarchy Phase 5d follow-up — after Process_Scheduled_Commitment / Process_Recurring_Commitment activates the just-created GC, query whether the platform auto-inserted a GiftDefaultDesignation. If a row is returned, Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process compares its GiftDesignationId to var_ResolvedDesignationId and either Updates it (Override changed the pick) or skips (already matches). If no row returned (e.g., Recurring where the Campaign has no GDD to seed from), the flow falls through to Assign_Build_Default_Designation → Create_GiftDefaultDesignation to insert one. This closes the gap where Scheduled/Recurring Override picks were silently discarded and where Recurring GCs could end up with no GDD at all.
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_GDD_Post_Process
recordLookups.label: Get GC GDD (Post-Process)

recordLookups.description: GDSC Item C — Loads all GDSCs on the parent GC (whichever leaf we're on). ParentRecordId comes from var_GDSCFanout_ParentGCId, stamped by Assign_Fanout_ParentId_FromCommitment (PP) or Assign_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC (Recurring first-payment) before this lookup. Returns rows → Loop_Fanout_GDSC_To_GSC iterates them. Returns 0 → loop drains immediately → Create_GSCs_FromGDSCs inserts an empty col_GSCs_FromGDSCs (no-op).
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_GDSCs
recordLookups.label: Get GC GDSCs

recordLookups.description: Load the full commitment record from the lookup Id so downstream logic has FulfillmentType and other fields.
recordLookups.name: Get_Looked_Up_Commitment
recordLookups.label: Get Looked-Up Commitment

recordLookups.description: Phase F2.1 (§Matching-gift schema wire-up). Loads FQS_Match_Ratio__c, FQS_Match_Annual_Individual_Maximum__c, and FQS_Matching_Gift_Program__c off the employer Account picked on Screen_Pick_Match_Employer. Consumed by formulaMatchAmountDefault (default numMatchAmount = donor amount × ratio) and by Decide_Match_Max_Exceeded (warn if entered match > annual max). Falls through to Screen_Set_Match_Amount regardless of whether the fields are populated — nulls are handled by the downstream formulas / decisions. Fault path routes to Err_Load matching all other lookups in this flow.
recordLookups.name: Get_Match_Employer
recordLookups.label: Get Match Employer

recordLookups.description: Active Campaigns for which any Contact on this Account is a CampaignMember. Empty collection is fine — the picker screen shows only the lookup escape hatch in that case. First-screen perf refactor 2026-08-04: the whole member-campaign chain (Get_CampaignMembers → Transform_Campaign_Ids_Into_Text_Strings → Get_Member_Campaigns) now fires AFTER Screen_Category rather than before, so pre-first-screen work is limited to Get_Account + Get_Account_Contacts + one Transform. Two entry points converge on Get_CampaignMembers: Assign_Screen_Auto_To_Effectives (normal Home / Account path — user just picked category on Screen_Category) and Decide_Skip_Category_HasPreselect (Opportunity Setup Commitment preselect path — bypasses Screen_Category but still needs member campaigns for the downstream picker). GC-context path uses Get_Campaign_For_Commitment (inherits from commitment) and does not traverse this chain. Connector targets Decide_Category so both entry paths land at the leaf router with member campaigns loaded.
recordLookups.name: Get_Member_Campaigns
recordLookups.label: Get Member Campaigns

recordLookups.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. After a monetary-leaf commitment lands and its schedule is activated, pull every GiftTransaction on the just-created GC whose TransactionDate is on or before today AND whose Status is anything OTHER than Paid. Broader than a plain Status='Unpaid' filter because the platform's default status for pre-activation fanned-out Expected GTs is 'Expected' (a Standard picklist value distinct from Unpaid). NotEqualTo 'Paid' captures Expected + Unpaid + Pending + Failed, i.e., every unreconciled row. Feeds Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments's datatable so the user can flag which past-dated payments have actually been received. Zero-row case (all future-dated fanout, no past dates) routes past the screen via Decide_Any_PastDue_GTs and rejoins the terminal chain at Decide_Create_Default_Designation.
recordLookups.name: Get_PastDue_GTs
recordLookups.label: Get Past-Due Expected GTs

recordUpdates.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. Bulk-updates the GiftTransactions that the user confirmed as received on Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments. col_ConfirmedPaidGTs was built by Loop_Confirm_Paid_GTs (each row has Id + Status=Paid). Fault path shares Err_Create — a failed Update leaves the GC + schedule + Expected GTs intact in the org and the user can reconcile manually via GT list views. Empty-collection case (user unchecked everything on the screen) is a no-op.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Confirmed_Paid_GTs
recordUpdates.label: Update Confirmed Paid GTs

recordUpdates.description: Phase F2 (launcher plan §Matching-gift branch §Amount, line 124). Persists the MatchingEmployerTransactionId pair on the donor GT after Create_Employer_GT returns the employer row's Id. Runs on both the Insert and Update donor-GT branches — reached from Assign_Pair_Onto_Donor_GT. rsv_GiftTransaction.Id was populated by Create_Gift_Transaction (Insert path) or Assign_Update_GT_Fields → Update_Gift_Transaction (Update path), so this recordUpdates always targets the correct donor row. Only rsv_GiftTransaction.MatchingEmployerTransactionId is changed since Save at Insert; on the Update path the earlier Update_Gift_Transaction already wrote Status=Paid + user-editable fields, so this second write is idempotent for those. Phase F3b: connector now routes to Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor (was → Decide_Match_Post_Route) to insert the two paired GiftSoftCredit rows before the post-match terminal split.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Donor_With_Pair
recordUpdates.label: Update Donor GT with Employer Pair

recordUpdates.description: Designation hierarchy Phase 5d follow-up — Update the platform-auto GDD on the just-created Scheduled/Recurring GC to point at var_ResolvedDesignationId. Reached from Assign_GC_GDD_Update_Fields when Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process detected a mismatch. Fault path routes to Err_Create — a failed Update leaves the GC + GDD in the platform-default state (Campaign default or Recurring cascade fallback), which is a graceful degradation of the Override rather than a hard failure.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GC_GDD
recordUpdates.label: Update GC Gift Default Designation

recordUpdates.description: Phase E2 (launcher plan §Pledge Payment logic). Posts an existing Expected GiftTransaction as paid. Runs on the Update branch of Pledge Payment (pkPledgePaymentMode=Update AND rsv_SelectedGT.Id set). rsv_GiftTransaction.Id is stamped by Assign_Update_GT_Fields to point at rsv_SelectedGT.Id, so this recordUpdates targets the selected row rather than inserting. Phase F2: connector routes to Decide_Insert_Employer_GT_Update (was Screen_Success). When no match is opted-in (pkNeedsMatch=No), that decision defaults straight to Screen_Success — the platform engine already fanned out GiftDefaultDesignation / GTDesignation when it materialized the Expected GT, so we do NOT re-run designation / soft credit fan-out on this path.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Gift_Transaction
recordUpdates.label: Update Gift Transaction

screens.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. Shown only when Get_PastDue_GTs returned ≥1 row (Decide_Any_PastDue_GTs). Renders past-dated Expected GiftTransactions as a multi-select flowruntime:datatable. The user checks the rows whose money has actually been received; downstream Loop_Confirm_Paid_GTs marks each as Paid. Unchecked rows stay Unpaid and surface in overdue reports for later reconciliation.
screens.name: Confirm_PastPayments
screens.label: Confirm - Past Payments Received

fields.name: PastPaymentsHelp
fields.fieldText:
Confirm which past payments have been received.


This commitment's schedule includes payments dated on or before today. Check the box next to each one that has actually been received — those will be marked Paid with a processed date of today. Leave a row unchecked to keep it as an outstanding Unpaid expected payment that can be reconciled later.

screens.description: Phase G5 (mismatch-warning polish). Confirmation summary interstitial on the Pledge Payment Update branch when the entered amount MATCHES the scheduled OriginalAmount (no mismatch to warn about). Reached only from Decide_Amount_Mismatch's default connector. Skipped on the mismatch path — Screen_Warning_Amount_Mismatch already summarizes amount + delta and this would be a redundant second interstitial. Single Next button → Assign_Update_GT_Fields → Update_Gift_Transaction.
